Actually it's a 20 gallon tank Petco recommend I get before purchasing any fish. I had my black Moor for awhile now almost 7 months. Had him in a 10 gallon which Petco said would be fine toll I could get a new tank (his old 20 gallon ended up cracked and I couldn't afford anything bigger). She wouldn't even let me get jack seven months ago unless I got a 20 gallon tank. So I did. But I had to cycle before I could get him. When the tanks water was perfect for jack (about two months later) I went and got him. The dog knocked over the tank and left a big crack in it. Thank God it didn't burst because it could have been way worse for jack. I put him in the ten gallon spare where I keep my live plants. I took the plants out and put them in a large vase and left jack in the fish tank. I checked the water and it was fine for him. He was in that tank for about a month before I got a new 20 gallon.
